title: The job you forgot
story: Yesterday you started an interactive job with 2 GPUs and closed your laptop without typing exit. It's still holding the GPUs, and the server is full. Find that job, cancel it, then start a fresh 1-GPU session.

lesson.title: Give your interactive jobs a time limit

parts.note: Your jobs. An interactive job shows up with the name `bash`.
End a job and free everything it holds.
Next time, add `--time`: Slurm ends the job after 2 hours even if you forget to `exit`.

lesson.why: An interactive job holds its GPUs until it ends, even while you're asleep.

tasks.text: Start an interactive job with 1 GPU

hints: `squeue --me` shows your jobs and their IDs. `scancel ID` ends one.
